Bash(node -e "const db=require\('./src/core/db.js'\);\(async\(\)=>{const r=await db.query\(\\"SELECT s.lot_code, w.warehouse_type AS kho, p.product_code, s.quantity, s.unit FROM inventory_stock s JOIN products p ON p.id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id=s.location_id LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id WHERE s.lot_code IN \('LSX00012','LSX00013'\) AND s.quantity<>0 ORDER BY s.lot_code, w.warehouse_type\\"\);console.log\('=== Tồn kho lô LSX00012 & LSX00013 ==='\);console.table\(r.rows\);console.log\('=== Công đoạn LSX00013 \(posted_qty\) ==='\);const t=await db.query\(\\"SELECT stage, actual_qty, status, posted_qty FROM production_tasks pt JOIN production_orders po ON po.id=pt.production_order_id WHERE po.order_code='LSX00013' ORDER BY seq\\"\);console.table\(t.rows\);process.exit\(0\);}\)\(\).catch\(e=>{console.error\(e.message\);process.exit\(1\)}\);")

Bash(node -e "const http=require\('http'\);const d=JSON.stringify\({username:'phamdinh',password:'phamdinh123'}\);const r=http.request\({host:'localhost',port:4000,path:'/api/auth/login',method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Content-Length':d.length}},res=>{let b='';res.on\('data',c=>b+=c\);res.on\('end',\(\)=>{const j=JSON.parse\(b\);if\(!j.user\){console.log\('LỖI:',j.message||b\);process.exit\(1\)}console.log\('User:',j.user.full_name,'| is_admin:',j.user.is_admin,'| role:',j.user.role_name\);const perms=j.user.permissions||{};const shown=Object.keys\(perms\).filter\(k=>perms[k].view\);console.log\('Module có quyền xem:',shown.join\(', '\)\);process.exit\(0\)}\)}\);r.write\(d\);r.end\(\)")
